description:
Create a new shift schedule in the Vicidial Admin interface to enforce agent working hours.

Login to the Vicidial Admin panel (Username: 6666, Password: andromeda) and navigate to the 'Shifts' section (usually found under Admin > Shifts or User Groups). 

Add a new shift with the following EXACT specifications:
- Shift ID: WKDAY9TO5
- Shift Name: Weekday Daytime 9-5
- Shift Start Time: 0900
- Shift Length: 8.00
- Shift Weekdays: Select ONLY Monday through Friday (do not include weekends)

Ensure the shift is Active and save your changes.
